description: Find what can replace a single ingredient, optionally under a dietary constraint (vegan, vegetarian, halal, dairy-free, pescatarian). Each result is marked "substitute" (same dish) or "adaptation" (result is a meaningfully different dish) - most swaps forced by a diet exclusion are adaptations, and the tool says so rather than overselling a swap as if the dish stayed the same. Precomputed and model-verified, not generated on the fly.

context.description: Dietary constraint the substitute must satisfy. Omit for the single best general substitute with no diet filter. Other constraints (gluten-free, allergen-free) are not supported - the corpus has no gluten/allergen data, so the tool would have to guess, and it does not.

ingredient.description: Ingredient name in any of the 7 site languages, or its English canonical form (e.g. "pork belly", "domuz göbeği", "Schweinebauch").

lang.description: Language for titles, ingredient names and URLs.

limit.description: Max substitutes to return, best first.

name: substitute_ingredient

declined.description: Set instead of an empty substitutes array explaining why there are none - a missing reason is a bug, not a deliberate silence.

ingredient_label.description: Ingredient name translated into the requested language.

kind.description: "substitute": swapping keeps the same dish. "adaptation": the result is a meaningfully different dish (e.g. pork belly -> beef short ribs for halal - still a rich braise, but not the same recipe). Never claim "substitute" when it is not one.

title: Find an ingredient substitute
